reason: Narrow pre-outcome clarification of the no-skill reference, repeated-delay uncertainty, freshness controls, and exact two-satellite measurement definition. The original preregistered gate remains auditable and controlling; no target, model family, delay grid, role boundary, or practical success criterion is changed.

corrected_no_skill_diagnostic.AUPRC_reference: positive prevalence of the 2016 threshold_and_rule_selection cohort itself
corrected_no_skill_diagnostic.Brier_reference: constant probability equal to fit-role positive prevalence, evaluated on the identical 2016 cohort
corrected_no_skill_diagnostic.MAX_TSS_above_zero_interpretation: screening condition only; because the threshold is selected on 2016, a positive maximum TSS may occur by chance and is not evidence that useful forecasting has been demonstrated

clean_signal_gate.interpretation: Passing the original gate authorizes the frozen delay/switching experiment. The corrected 2016-prevalence AUPRC comparison is reported alongside it and constrains interpretation; neither gate is described as independent forecast-skill evidence.

repeated_delay_evidence.bootstrap_unit_positive: target crossing episode, with every associated issue and every delay variant kept together
repeated_delay_evidence.bootstrap_unit_negative: contiguous seven-day quiet block, with every contained issue and every delay variant kept together

freshness_isolation_controls.explanatory_requirement: A claimed freshness crossover must be discussed against both the clean-joint reference and the delayed single-feed control so that deterioration from stale information is distinguished from an intrinsically weaker joint model.

proton.quantity: five-minute integral proton flux above 10 MeV
proton.direction_definition: documented Av product, the average of the NOAA eastward- and westward-looking GOES-13 sensors

xrs.A: A_AVG / 0.85, 0.05-0.4 nm, W/m^2, quality flag must be zero
xrs.B: B_AVG / 0.7, 0.1-0.8 nm, W/m^2, quality flag must be zero

measurement_definition.forbidden_description: Do not call this pair the historical SWPC primary stream or an operational constellation replay.
